blocks.text: Kirchhoff ke rules circuit analysis ke do basic principles (bunyadi usool) hain jo circuits mein current aur voltage maloom karne mein madad dete hain. Yeh khaas taur par un complex (uljha hua) circuits ke liye kaam aate hain jo sirf Ohm's law aur series ya parallel combination (jor) se solve (hal) nahi ho sakte.
